WITH daily_ypa AS (
  SELECT fish_date_t AS d, SUM(yt)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY fish_date_t
),
daily_upw AS (
  SELECT date_t AS d, AVG(cuti) AS cuti, AVG(beuti) AS beuti
  FROM upwelling
  GROUP BY date_t
)
SELECT
  corr(u.cuti, y.ypa) AS corr_cuti_lag0,
  corr(u7.cuti, y.ypa) AS corr_cuti_lag7,
  corr(u10.cuti, y.ypa) AS corr_cuti_lag10,
  corr(u14.cuti, y.ypa) AS corr_cuti_lag14,
  corr(u.beuti, y.ypa) AS corr_beuti_lag0,
  corr(u7.beuti, y.ypa) AS corr_beuti_lag7,
  corr(u10.beuti, y.ypa) AS corr_beuti_lag10,
  corr(u14.beuti, y.ypa) AS corr_beuti_lag14,
  count(*) AS n
FROM daily_ypa y
JOIN daily_upw u ON u.d = y.d
LEFT JOIN daily_upw u7 ON u7.d = y.d - 7
LEFT JOIN daily_upw u10 ON u10.d = y.d - 10
LEFT JOIN daily_upw u14 ON u14.d = y.d - 14

WITH daily_ypa AS (
  SELECT fish_date_t AS d, SUM(yt)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY fish_date_t
),
daily_sst AS (
  SELECT CAST(ts_t AS INTEGER) AS d, AVG(wtmp_c) AS sst
  FROM pier
  GROUP BY CAST(ts_t AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT
  corr(s0.sst, y.ypa) AS corr_sst_lag0,
  corr(s3.sst, y.ypa) AS corr_sst_lag3,
  corr(s7.sst, y.ypa) AS corr_sst_lag7,
  corr(s14.sst, y.ypa) AS corr_sst_lag14,
  count(*) AS n
FROM daily_ypa y
JOIN daily_sst s0 ON s0.d = y.d
LEFT JOIN daily_sst s3 ON s3.d = y.d - 3
LEFT JOIN daily_sst s7 ON s7.d = y.d - 7
LEFT JOIN daily_sst s14 ON s14.d = y.d - 14

SELECT (fish_date_doy/10)::INT*10 AS doy_bin, cls,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::DOUBLE/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa, COUNT(*) AS boat_days
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 182 AND 213
  AND cls IN ('three_quarter','hd_am','hd_pm','overnight','day_1_5')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (fish_date_doy/10)::INT*10 AS doy_bin, cls,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::DOUBLE/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa, COUNT(*) AS boat_days
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=1 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 180 AND 213
  AND cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
